posts.en:
dsh-settings-nav-organizer is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups and a fold toggle in General settings.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-5c5147e0d111d14497b8.html
